title: Request for Proposals: Marketing Agency Services — Chicago Education Fund
snippet: The Chicago Education Fund invites qualified marketing agencies to submit proposals for a 12-month communications and brand strategy engagement. Proposals due May 30, 2026.

title: RFP: Digital Fundraising Consulting — Bay Area Environmental Council
snippet: Bay Area Environmental Council seeks a fundraising consulting firm to support its 2026 annual fund campaign. Budget: $40,000–$60,000. Deadline: June 15, 2026.

title: Nonprofit RFP: Website Redesign — Habitat for Humanity Chicago
snippet: Habitat for Humanity Chicago is accepting proposals from web design agencies for a full website redesign. Proposals accepted through July 1, 2026. Contact: procurement@habitatchicago.org

title: Request for Proposals: PR and Media Relations — Advocacy Alliance
snippet: Advocacy Alliance seeks a PR agency to support its 2026 policy campaign. Estimated contract value: $25,000. Submissions due April 30, 2026.

title: Marketing Services RFP — United Way of Greater Los Angeles
snippet: United Way of Greater Los Angeles requests proposals from marketing agencies for integrated campaign management services. RFP open through June 30, 2026. Budget up to $120,000.
